title: Dexterity
wikitext:
{{about|the dexterity attribute|the passive skill|Dexterity (passive skill)}}

The '''dexterity''' [[attribute]] is a measure of a character's agility and expertise. Dexterity is required to use dexterity-based [[equipment]] and [[skill]]s.

Dexterity also provides certain inherent bonuses:
* Every 1 dexterity grants an additional 2 [[accuracy]] rating.
* Every 5 dexterity grants 1% increased [[evasion]] rating.

==Additional Dexterity Scaling==

===Additional stat per x dexterity===
Certain [[unique item|unique items]] can impart additional scaling to dexterity:
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=items.class_id != "Jewel" AND item_stats.id LIKE "%per\_%\_dex%"
|large=1
|stat=1
}}

===Modifiers===
The following [[modifier]]s can impart additional scaling to dexterity:
{{modifier table
|q_tables=spawn_weights
|q_join=mods._pageID=spawn_weights._pageID
|q_where = mods.stat_text LIKE "%per\_%\_dex%"
|generation_type=1
|level=1
|stat_text=1
|spawn_weights=1
}}


===Threshold jewel===
Dexterity [[Threshold Jewels|Threshold]] [[List_of_unique_jewels|Unique Jewels]] provide additional benefits to specific [[skills]] when 40 '''Dexterity''' is present within the jewel's medium radius on the [[Passive skill|passive tree]].
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=items.class_id = "Jewel" AND item_stats.id LIKE "%with_%_dex_in_radius%"
|large=1
|stat=1
}}

===Other jewels===
These other [[List_of_unique_jewels|unique jewels]] provide additional scaling based on nearby allocated Dexterity on the passive tree:
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=items.class_id = "Jewel" AND (item_stats.id LIKE "%per_%_dex%" OR item_stats.id LIKE "%dex%apply%") AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%with_%_dex_in_radius%"
|large=1
|stat=1
}}

===Keystone===
Some [[keystones]] provide other scaling options for Dexterity.
*[[Magebane]]


==Base Dexterity==
The [[Ranger]] starts with 32 base '''Dexterity''', the highest of any [[class]]. 

The [[Shadow]] and [[Duelist]] start with 23 Dexterity, the [[Scion]] with 20, and the [[Marauder]], [[Templar]], and [[Witch]] with 14.
==Modifying Dexterity==
Dexterity can be increased by stacking base Dexterity and/or All Attributes and X% increased Dexterity and/or Attributes modifiers.
===Implicit Dexterity on Items===
Many [[Modifiers#Implicit_modifiers|implicit modifiers]] provide base dexterity on items:

{{Drop enabled base item table
|tables = item_mods, item_stats
|join = items._pageID=item_mods._pageID, item_mods.id=item_stats.mod_id
|where = item_mods.is_implicit=true
  AND (item_stats.id like "additional_%dexterity%" OR item_stats.id="additional_all_attributes")
|level=1
|stat_column1_header=Dexterity
|stat_column1_stat_format=add
|stat_column1_stat1_id=additional_dexterity
|stat_column1_stat2_id=additional_strength_and_dexterity
|stat_column1_stat3_id=additional_dexterity_and_intelligence
|stat_column1_stat4_id=additional_all_attributes
}}

===Dexterity on Equipment===

Weapons and armour must have dexterity as an attribute requirement in order for dexterity to appear as an affix. Dexterity affixes can appear on the following base item categories:

* [[Amulets]], [[Rings]], and [[Quivers]]
* [[Armour (equipment)]] with dexterity as an attribute requirement, i.e. anything that provides [[evasion]] as an implicit defence. 
* [[Weapons]] with dexterity as an attribute requirement, including [[Axes]], [[Swords]], [[Claws]], [[Daggers]], and [[Bows]].

The dexterity affixes range from {{c|mod|+8 to 55}} and are bracketed by [[item level]]. Dexterity as an affix is always a suffix. The highest dexterity suffix is {{c|mod|of the Wind}}. The item level required for this affix is 82.

Crafting benches have recipes which allow adding dexterity to non-dexterity-based armour with a value from {{c|mod|+15 to 30}}. The recipes area unlocked with game progress.  More powerful hybrid variants can be unlocked by [[Veiled mod|unveiling]].

[[Jewels]] have their own suffixes which grant dexterity. Keep in mind that jewels can only have 4 affixes: 2 prefixes and 2 suffixes.
* {{c|mod|of Dexterity}} from {{c|mod|+12 to 16}}
* {{c|mod|of Athletics}} from {{c|mod|+8 to 10}} (Dexterity and Strength)
* {{c|mod|of Cunning}} from {{c|mod|+8 to 10}} (Dexterity and Intelligence)
* {{c|mod|of Adaption}} from {{c|mod|+6 to 8}} (all Attributes)

In addition, [[Essence|Essences]] [[Deafening Essence of Sorrow|of Sorrow]] guarantee dexterity of {{c|mod|+13 to 58}} on any non-weapon equipment, potentially higher than without essences. This also has the added possibility of dexterity on [[belts]] and non-dexterity armour.

===All Attributes on Equipment===
{{c|mod|All Attributes}} affixes can appear on the following base item categories. These modifiers are always suffixes.

* [[Amulets]] from {{c|mod|+1 to 32}}
* [[Rings]] from {{c|mod|+1 to 16}}
* [[Jewels]] from {{c|mod|+6 to 8}} ({{c|mod|of Adaption}})

The game has an {{c|mod|All Attributes}} crafting suffix mod that can be discovered in the lab [[Trial of Ascendancy|trial]] in [[The Tunnel]]. The mod {{c|mod|+(10 to 13) to all Attributes}} can be crafted onto any item except for a [[flask]], [[belt]], [[jewel]], or [[map]].

===Unique Items with Additional Dexterity===
Certain [[unique items]] provide bonuses to base dexterity or all [[attribute]]s.

{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=item_stats.id like "additional_%dexterity%" OR item_stats.id="additional_all_attributes"
|level=1
|stat_column1_header=Dexterity
|stat_column1_stat_format=add
|stat_column1_stat1_id=additional_dexterity
|stat_column1_stat2_id=additional_strength_and_dexterity
|stat_column1_stat3_id=additional_dexterity_and_intelligence
|stat_column1_stat4_id=additional_all_attributes
}}

===Increasing Dexterity===
A number of [[unique item|unique items]] provide percent (%) increases and reductions to dexterity. All dexterity from equipment and passives will be scaled by these modifiers.

{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=item_stats.id="dexterity_+%" or item_stats.id="all_attributes_+%"
|level=1
|stat_column1_header=Dexterity
|stat_column1_format=%s%%
|stat_column1_stat_format=add
|stat_column1_stat1_id=dexterity_+%
|stat_column1_stat2_id=all_attributes_+%
}}

===Other Ways to Modify Dexterity===
Converting one attribute to another is called ''transforming''. This can be done on the [[passive skill tree]] by socketing certain unique [[jewels]]. In a large radius, they will transform one attribute - granted by allocated skills in the area - to another attribute.

{| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center;"
|+ Attribute-transforming jewels
|-
! From/To
! Strength
! Dexterity
! Intelligence
|-
! Strength
| {{n/a}} || {{il|Fluid Motion}} || {{il|Brute Force Solution}}
|-
! Dexterity
| {{il|Inertia}} || {{n/a}} || {{il|Fertile Mind}}
|-
! Intelligence
| {{il|Efficient Training}} || {{il|Careful Planning}} || {{n/a}}
|}

==Passives==
There are [[passive skill]] nodes that grant additional dexterity or a combination of bonuses including dexterity.

{{Query base passive skills
|where=passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%dexterity%"
AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT LIKE "%brequel%"
}}

===Masteries===
The following [[Passive Mastery|Masteries]] are related to Dexterity:
{{Query masteries}}

==Cluster Jewel Passives==
The following cluster jewel passives are related to Dexterity
{{Passive skill table
|q_where=
  passive_skills.id LIKE "affliction%"
  AND (passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%increased dexterity%" OR passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%to dexterity%")
  AND NOT passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "+10 to dexterity"
|large=1
|stat_text=1
}}

===Ascendancy Passives===

There are a few [[Ascendancy]] passives for the [[Scion]]'s [[Ascendant]] subclass which grant dexterity.

{{Query ascendancy passive skills
|where=passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%dexterity%"
}}
